short_description: Acknowledge enquiries, run conflict/eligibility checks, scope proposals, secure sign-off, and hand off to delivery.

questions.question: Where do enquiries arrive and who acknowledges them?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Website contact form, partner referrals, or email; practice manager acknowledges...

questions.question: What information is required to assess fit, scope and urgency?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Client sector, scope summary, key deadlines, budget indication...

questions.question: Are conflict, independence, eligibility or other checks required before proceeding?
options: Yes — formal conflict / independence check logged before scoping
Informal partner check during meetings
No conflict checks required
Not sure

questions.question: Who defines scope, estimates effort and approves commercial terms?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Lead consultant drafts scope; managing partner approves fee and terms...

questions.question: How are proposal changes and client approvals recorded?
options: Tracked in proposal / e-signature system with version history
Multiple emailed PDFs and email reply confirmations
Verbal yes followed by later paperwork
Not sure

questions.question: What must be signed or paid before work begins?
options: Signed engagement letter AND initial retainer/deposit
Signed engagement letter only
Sometimes work begins on email approval while paperwork catches up
Not sure

questions.question: How is the accepted engagement handed to the delivery team with all commitments intact?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Partner briefs delivery lead verbally, or posts proposal summary in project tool...

short_description: Open client matters, manage milestones and client inputs, control scope changes, review quality, and close cleanly.

questions.question: What triggers the formal start of a matter or project?
options: Signed engagement + deposit cleared + matter ID opened
Partner sends email telling team to start
Kickoff call scheduled
Not sure

questions.question: What information and documents must be available before work starts?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Client intake packet, prior filings/reports, stakeholder contacts...

questions.question: Who owns the matter, each workstream and quality review?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Accountable manager owns timeline; analysts draft deliverables; senior partner reviews...

questions.question: How are milestones, deadlines, dependencies and client inputs tracked?
options: Central practice/project management board with due dates
Shared spreadsheet updated in weekly meetings
Each consultant manages their own tasks and emails
Not sure

questions.question: How are scope changes or additional work assessed and approved?
options: Formal change request approved in writing before extra work starts
Extra work often absorbed or discussed later at invoicing
Partner approves ad hoc over calls
Not sure

questions.question: How are client updates and work products reviewed before release?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Peer/partner sign-off checklist required before sending client deliverables...

questions.question: What is required to close the matter and capture lessons or outstanding obligations?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Final invoice issued, files archived, debrief notes logged...

short_description: Capture billable time and expenses, validate entries, approve write-offs, issue invoices, and follow up arrears.

questions.question: When and where do staff record time and expenses?
options: Daily in practice time-tracking software
End of week or end of month from calendar/email memory
Spreadsheets emailed to finance
Not sure

questions.question: What information is required for each entry to be billable and traceable?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Matter code, task category, clear client-facing narrative, receipt for expenses...

questions.question: Who checks entries for completeness, accuracy and client terms?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Billing partner or project manager reviews draft pre-bill each month...

questions.question: How are write-offs, fixed fees, disbursements or exceptions approved?
options: Documented partner approval thresholds for adjustments
Partners adjust pre-bills manually without formal log
Not sure

questions.question: How is approved work transferred into an invoice?
options: Direct sync from time system to accounting software
Finance re-types approved hours/amounts into accounting tool
Manual Word/PDF invoice creation
Not sure

questions.question: Who checks and sends the invoice, and how are errors corrected?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Finance prepares draft, manager approves, finance emails PDF...

questions.question: How are overdue invoices and disputed items assigned and followed up?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Finance sends automated reminders; partner steps in past 30 days...

short_description: Request required client documents, track missing items, verify quality/versions, and keep delivery teams synced.

questions.question: Who identifies the documents needed and how is the list created?
options: Standardised checklist per service type tailored by lead
Written fresh in an email each time by the consultant
Requested piecemeal as work progresses
Not sure

questions.question: How are requests sent and how does the client know what is required?
options: Client upload portal showing checklist items and due dates
Emailed bulleted list or attached spreadsheet
Messages across email and WhatsApp
Not sure

questions.question: Where are incoming documents received and stored?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Clients email attachments which staff rename and save into SharePoint/Drive...

questions.question: Who checks completeness, legibility, version and relevance?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Admin coordinator checks files upon arrival, or specialist discovers gaps later...

questions.question: How are missing items and deadlines tracked?
options: Portal/tracker highlights overdue items automatically
Manual checklist spreadsheet reviewed weekly
No central tracker — staff check inbox threads before meetings
Not sure

questions.question: What access or confidentiality controls apply?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Matter-level folder permissions; encrypted link instead of plain email...

questions.question: How does the delivery team know the document set is complete and current?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Status changed to 'Ready for delivery' and team notified...
